Jump Street investigates the rape of a college student after the reporter of the crime seems to disappear.

McCann is assigned to controversial missing persons case and uncovers a blackmail scheme.

McCann investigates a devil worshipping cult at a local high school.

The death of a friend causes Fuller to worry about his age.

A girl's death forces Officers Hanson and Penhall to go undercover at the exclusive West Chadway Prep School.
A pyromaniac at an all-girl school has undercover cop Judy Hoffs blazing a trail - to a prom-night inferno.
Following his death, Captain Jenko's replacement leads the squad to the rescue of a school held hostage.
A 16-year-old turns tricks for home security codes, leading Ioki on a trail of burglary and prostitution.

Hanson goes "punk" to infiltrate rival gangs in an attempt to halt their destruction and rescue one member.
The Jump Street team goes undercover to investigate a suspected kidnapper Edison Coulter.
A sixteen-year-old crack dealer is mysteriously murdered in the seedy world of narcotics and prostitution.

The Jump Street squad puts a sting on a bar and cope with the drunk driving arrest of their own captain.
Fuller and Hoffs go undercover at a violent high school where both student and faculty carry lethal weapons.
loki faces a paternity suit and jail when a teen fingers him as the father of her child.
Hanson and Hoffs try to diffuse the potentially explosive situation in the racially divided Burgard High.
Hanson, Penhall, and loki investigate a rash of brutal assaults on gay men.
Officer Hanson is kidnapped endangering his life, and that of a Hollywood heartthrob he was sent to protect.
When a gymnast dies of a steroid overdose, Penhall and Hoffs go undercover to discover the source.

Officer Hanson experiences a late teenage rebellion, putting his friendships and his future in jeopardy.
Frustratingly helpless in a case he can't solve, Hanson befriends a teen AIDS patient he is asked to protect.
On Valentine's Day the Jump Street squad plays poker and reminisces about their worst dates.

Hanson and Penhall pose as battling brothers to infiltrate a gang of kids from the wrong side of the tracks.

The Jump Street gang may lose Judy Hoffs when she falls for a guy on the wrong side of the law.

When a young murderer and his bride are busted at their wedding, a desperate groom takes Hoffs hostage.
The Jump Street cops must find temporary jobs when school's out for summer, and maybe forever.
Hanson comes to blows with a new partner whom he suspects is as bigoted as the racists they're investigating.

When drug-dealing gets out of hand at a prestigious performing arts school, the team must join the act.
The Jump Street cops go undercover on the streets as homeless runaways to find a missing teenager.
When the controversial host of a radio show is nearly killed, Booker takes over to flush out the guilty party.

Hanson and Penhall investigate student beatings at an off campus bar, discovering an illegal gambling ring.
Undercover at a nightclub, Hanson rekindles an old romance while uncovering a drug-money-laundering operation.

A principal's controversial tactics go too far in his attempt to clean up a decaying inner city school.
While investigating fires, Penhall and Hanson meet a student whose psychic powers lead them to an arsonist.
Hanson and loki face their personal demons when they go to solve burglaries in an exclusive neighborhood.
While undercover as a medical student, Hoffs is raped by a fellow student but is reluctant to report the crime
Hanson and Penhall go undercover at a high school to find a lonely student, guilty of killing a teacher's wife
The team embark on a motorcycle trip to bust the man responsible for loki, Hanson, and Booker's misfortunes.
While on a stake-out watching a house of suspected burglars, Hoffs witnesses a father abusing his family.
